source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Since the SK6812 has a minimum supply voltage of 3.5–3.7V, a 3.3V supply is below specification and the LED may not illuminate reliably. It should be powered from 5V, with the 74AHCT1G125 level shifter (LCSC C151417) used on the data line. At 5V, the data threshold is 3.5V, which exceeds the ESP32 output level. This is already part of the design, so no other changes are required; simply replace the IRLML2402 with the 74AHCT1G125.
